part: ESP32-2432S028R "Cheap Yellow Display" (CYD) — ESP32 + 2.8" 320×240 touch screen
check_before_buying: Exact name ESP32-2432S028R. Both the ILI9341 version and the two-USB "CYD2USB" (ST7789) version work — the firmware detects the panel.

part: Ultrasonic sensor, 3.3 V capable: RCWL-1601 or HC-SR04P
check_before_buying: Listing must say it works from 3 V–5.5 V. A plain 5 V-only HC-SR04 needs the fallback divider.

part: SG90 micro servo, positional (180°), with horns and its 2 screws
check_before_buying: Not "360°" or "continuous rotation". The single-arm horn must come in the bag.
Often one is in the CYD box — you need three (CN1, P3, P1).

part: Male-male Dupont jumper pins (or 3 short male-male jumpers)
check_before_buying: Join the servo plug to the cable.
Only if the board resets when the servo moves.

part: self-tapping screws that come with the SG90
check_before_buying: servo flange → the two bosses under the roof

part: small screw that comes with the SG90 horn (optional)
check_before_buying: horn → head foot, only if the press fit is loose
